how: Vendors' own current docs and pricing pages, read on 4 Nov 2026 (WebSearch/WebFetch). Only facts found there are stated; 'not verified' where a page did not say. Our size: 28,953 chunks x 384-d float32 = 44.5 MB of vectors, about 30 MB of text and metadata.
considerations: Dense + BM25 fused inside the store, so one call returns the fused list (we fuse with RRF, k = 60)
HR-CONFIDENTIAL must never reach Emma: the filter must hold before ranking, not after a top-k is cut
28,953 chunks now; ten times that in a few years
The whole search inside 200 ms at p95, network included
Who patches, scales and wakes up at night
A new embedding model means re-embedding every chunk: build a new collection, then switch
Departments, or one index per customer in a SaaS
About 75 MB raw: every free tier is the question, not the price list
Dashboards, snapshots, upgrades, one more system to run

dedicated.name: Qdrant (OSS + Cloud)
hybrid: Query API: prefetch dense + BM25, fused by RRF in the engine; BM25 on a full-text index since v1.20 (Oct 2026)
region: EU: GCP Frankfurt on our free cluster; London not verified
free: Free forever: 1 GB RAM, 4 GB disk; paused after a week idle

dedicated.name: Pinecone (serverless)
hybrid: Dense + sparse in one index with a weight; full-text (GA Sep 2026) is a separate search, fused by you
region: No London; EU (Ireland, Frankfurt) from the $20/month Builder plan
free: Starter is free but us-east-1 only

dedicated.name: Weaviate (OSS + Cloud)
hybrid: BM25F + vector in one query, fused in the engine
free: 100,000 objects, no backups: fits now, not at ten times

dedicated.name: Milvus / Zilliz Cloud
hybrid: Built-in BM25 function (2.5+); hybrid_search with an RRF ranker on the server
filter: Expression filters; during the search not verified

dedicated.name: Chroma Cloud
hybrid: Sparse index + RRF in the Search API; the BM25 vectors are computed on your side
region: US East and GCP Belgium; no London
free: $5 of free credit a month; our size costs pennies

dedicated.name: Turbopuffer
hybrid: Vector + BM25, fused by RRF on the server
dedicated.ops: Managed (BYOC on Enterprise) · Notion, Linear, Atlassian (vendor-stated)

existing.name: Postgres + pgvector
hybrid: Dense, plus Postgres full-text (not BM25), fused in your own SQL; real BM25 needs ParadeDB pg_search, which Neon retired on 21 Sep 2026
filter: HNSW filters after the index scan; iterative scans (0.8+) restore recall
existing.ops: Both · row-level security, backups, the database you already run

existing.name: Elasticsearch / OpenSearch
hybrid: BM25 native + kNN, RRF retriever; self-managed Elastic needs the Enterprise licence for RRF; OpenSearch RRF since 2.19
filter: A filter inside the kNN query applies during the search
free: No lasting free tier (Elastic Serverless example: about $24/month)

existing.name: Azure AI Search
hybrid: BM25 + HNSW in one request, RRF on the server, optional semantic reranker
filter: Pre-filter during HNSW; security trimming by group filter
free: Free tier is 50 MB: our 75 MB does not fit
existing.ops: Managed · the natural pick in a Microsoft shop

existing.name: Google Vertex AI Vector Search
hybrid: Dense + sparse in one index with RRF; you compute the sparse (BM25) vectors

existing.name: AWS: S3 Vectors · Bedrock KB
hybrid: S3 Vectors: vectors only, no keyword search; Bedrock KB hybrid only on RDS, OpenSearch Serverless, MongoDB

pick.name: Qdrant
why: Hybrid inside the engine: dense + BM25 in one call, fused by RRF (k = 60, as our rag.rrf)
Filters run inside the HNSW search, on payload indexes: Emma's must_not confidential holds before ranking
The same code on a laptop (Docker, open source) and in the cloud; a free cluster that holds all 28,953 chunks
A dashboard to look at the stored points and a console to run searches
Aliases: a new embedding model is a new collection and one atomic switch
caveats: Measured on our cluster: the default HNSW width lost recall (0.434 against 0.566 exact); set hnsw_ef and measure
Its BM25 splits ERR-PO-0412 into err, po, 0412; our rag.BM25 keeps the code whole and scores a little higher
Free clusters pause after a week unused and are deleted after four; ours is in Frankfurt (EU), not London
pick.caveats_source: first two: logs/v5_store_ef.json and logs/v5_store_cloud.json (measured 4 Nov 2026); third: qdrant.tech/documentation/cloud/create-cluster/
pick.else: Already on Postgres? pgvector keeps one database. A Microsoft shop with strict UK residency: Azure AI Search, UK South.
